name: Chuvashia (Chuvash SSR, 1990–1992)
description: A red field with a blue vertical stripe at the hoist, a yellow hammer and sickle beneath a yellow-bordered red star in the upper hoist, and the inscription 'Чувашская ССР / Чăваш ССР' in Russian and Chuvash in yellow.
history: The RSFSR-pattern flag of the Chuvash ASSR with the inscription changed to 'Chuvash SSR' after the sovereignty declaration of October 1990. It was replaced on 29 April 1992 by the present flag with the Tree of Life.

features.role: inscription 'Чувашская ССР / Чăваш ССР' in Russian and Chuvash
